title: ID0419099-DC/Si-D/FR-{MP / P6 170000692}Terminal candidate list empty
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: My colleague was on site today around 12:38 (local time), and it appears that the terminal on this charger is no longer operational. The screen of the chargeris displaying the error: "Terminal candidate list empty." It’s a bit surprising, since the charger was still working on March 30, 2025, when a transaction was successfully recorded. Based on previous similar situations, this issue is often linked to a faulty CORA10 — but do we have any idea what might have caused it to fail? To assist with the investigation, I have attached photos showing the error both in the logs and on the HMI. Could you please confirm if the CORA10 is indeed the cause of the issue? If so, can we move forward with a replacement?
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-15

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419099-DC/Si-D/FR-{MP / P6 170000692}Terminal candidate list empty CRM:02681000076
additional_info.body:
Hello Team
If we are getting "Terminal Candidate List Empty" this means either the card reader might be defective, or the terminal has wrong configuration.
Tol resolve this, the termina; must be forced to fetch configuration from host by either re-commissioning or by using diagnostics with TS3 tool.
If this does not resolve this issue, then please go ahead and replace the card reader.
Kindly refer the below mark schematic and check the connection.
Additionally, please carry the spare
Card Reader COR-A10
and
OPM-C60
in case a replacement is required during the visit.
PZ2-: 8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1
PZ3-:8EM5903-0AA02-5AA7 (Please confirm once as per the existing)
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar

change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
